## Restyle a track (cover its melody) - YuE 2

**A reference track in, the same tune out in a new style.** The one restyle route in the repo: SheetSage2
transcribes the reference's **melody** into ABC notation (`SheetSage2AudioToABC`, previewed on node 6) and
`YuE2GenerateMusic(mode='melody')` re-renders from it with a **style and lyrics you write**. ACE-Step's
style flow only *keeps* a reference (E5), so this is the capability it cannot reach - and the user's ears
confirm the cover is recognisably the reference's tune, restyled (E12d).

- **the reference** goes on `LoadAudio` (any audio file in ComfyUI's `input/`); a 30 s reference covers in
  **65 s**.
- **`STYLE`** (node 7) is the idiom to change it into - the shipped example is industrial rock.
- **`LYRICS`** (node 7) is new text: the reference's *melody* is kept, its *words* are not. New words only land when the source has a sung vocal line - an instrumental's transcribed `Vocal` line is all rests, and E22's added lyric was not sung.
- **`max_duration` must be at least the reference's length.** The model chooses the duration itself and this
  only bounds it - unlike ACE-Step, where the duration is a constant we set. So **you cannot target a length**: the cap only bounds, and the model stops when its ABC phrase ends (E22: a 30 s instrumental at cap 30 came out 27.7 s with a 188-word lyric, 29.5 s with none).
- **`mode`** is `melody` (a cover); `full` writes a new song instead.
- **node 6 (`PreviewAny`) shows the ABC** that SheetSage2 transcribed - the way to see whether the melody was
  read at all. It is two-voice (`Vocal` + `Ins`); an all-rests `Vocal` line means the reference was
  instrumental.

**Licence: `cc-by-nc-4.0` (`Comfy-Org/YuE2`) - non-commercial, research only.** And **a transcript is not a presence test**:
Whisper read 0-19 words on takes whose vocal the ears plainly hear (E12c), so never call a take instrumental
from a transcript.

---
*How to run it: story **S22** in `HOWTO.md`  ·  Why it is this way: **E12/E12d/E22** in `audio/EXPERIMENTS.md`.*

widgets_values: Industrial rock, hammering machine percussion with metallic clangs, distorted bass, cold analog synth, shouted male lead with a gang chorus, gritty lo-fi production, relentless and mechanical

[Verse]
Steel is breathing in the dark
Pistons counting out the hour
Every window blind with sparks
Every hand a kind of power
Hammers fall like steady rain
On the anvil of the day
We are forging something nameless
From the rust and from the clay

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Verse]
Furnace glow along the floor
Shadows walk the factory wall
We have heard the engines roar
And we never once will fall
Oil and smoke and borrowed light
Every rivet set in time
We will work into the night
Till the morning bells will chime

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Bridge]
And when the metal sings
And when the silence breaks
We will know the shape of things
By everything it makes

[Final Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Outro]
Turn the wheel, turn the wheel
Hold the line
